Many of these small, lightly-armed, and enclosed '''patrol craft''', or patrol fighters, were utilized throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were considered a cheaper alternative to the similarly-used [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Twin-pod cloud car]].<ref name="CCG Light">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Patrol Craft (Light)}}</ref> They were sometimes used as pleasure craft by wealthy eccentrics. The craft could be found on planets including [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CCG Dark" />
